additivity_rule.reason: The Release corpus is already post several preprocessing operations. A future representation/end-to-end protocol must explicitly define and measure remaining boundaries before additive end-to-end claims are allowed.

component_B_existing_release_corpus.important_boundary: Corpus already lies downstream of raw parsing, flow reconstruction, supervised matching/filtering, packet selection/truncation, and masking/encoding.
